content:
Update: All M6 Mac mini configurations are now back in-stock at Amazon for pre-order.

Price drops are still live on AirPods Pro 3 and AirPods Max 2 at $120 off, just make sure you scope out AirTag 2 at the lowest price ever while you still can (from $20 each). Apple has now unleashed the updated M6 Mac mini, pre-orders are now live, and you can land one at over $500 off with a mid-range M4 Mac mini trade-in at Apple (more details here). While not technical a deal, the next-generation Apple Polishing Cloth released today at a much lower $9, and we also have $400 off this 48GB M5 Pro MacBook Pro. The Twelve South TimePorter Watch Strap Organizer is under $21 Prime shipped right now and you can get a closer look below.

One of the best Apple deals of the year: New 2026 AirTag 2 now down as low as $20 each

While we are starting to see some of the best Apple deals from last week jump back up in price, this week ushered in a fresh new offer – the best price ever on the 2026 AirTag 2 down as low as $20 a pop on Amazon.

Amazon is still offering the single AirTag 2 listing down at the $24 Prime shipped all-time low – this is best deal we have tracked since release on the single listing.

  • AirTag 2 $24 (Reg. $29) – Matching all-time low
  • AirTag 2 4-pack $80 (Reg. $99) – NEW all-time low

However, if you can put four of them to use, or just find a buddy to go in on the 4-pack with you, the price is now even lower at just $20 a pop.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $200 (Reg. $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $429 (Reg. $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (Reg. $129)

Next-gen M6 Mac mini pre-order deals now live: $500+ off with M4 trade-ins

Update: the M6 Mac mini and M5 Pro Mac mini pre-orders are now live at Amazon:

  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/256GB $899
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/512GB $1,099
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 24GB/512GB $1,299
  • 2026 Mac mini M5 Pro 24GB/512GB $1,699

Apple has officially unleashed the new M6 Mac mini and pre-orders are now live alongside the next-generation M5 Pro model and the new Mac Studio. You can land the M6 Mac mini at $374 with a mid-range M4 trade-in.

M6 Mac mini pre-orders now live

***Note: We will be scouring the web for pre-order deal opportunities all morning – we suspect there will be some notable trade-in options and even some potential gift card promotions landing as soon as today if he new machines land at Amazon, Best Buy, and elsewhere.

Just after stock on the now previous-gen Mac mini all but entirely disappeared at retail, Apple has now unveiled its all-new mini Mac. The first Mac to carry the new M6 chip, and set within a familiar form-factor, it starts with 512GB of RAM and is now available for pre-order on the official Apple site:

  • M6 Mac mini 16GB/256GB from $899
  • M5 Pro Mac mini 24GB/512GB from $1,699

M6 Mac mini trade-in deals

Apple is of course offering some savings on the new Mac mini with trade-ins right now. For example, a mid-range M4 Mac mini with 24GB of RAM and 512GB of storage will net you $525 off the price of the M6 Mac mini right now – leaving you with a total price at $374.

All of the details you need on the new Mac mini and Mac Studio await below:

Tim Cook solidifies legacy with next-generation Apple Polishing Cloth, now available for $9

You’ll want to pay close attention to 9to5Mac this morning as Apple has just unleashed the next-gen M6 and M5 Ultra chips as well as the updated Mac mini and Mac Studio models that house them. That’s exciting or whatever, but Mr. Cook has decided to truly go out with a bang as Apple has now released an all-new, next-generation Polishing Cloth for just $9.

AirPods deals disappearing quick, score the 2026 AirPods Max 2 at $120 off while you still can

We have caught some fantastic deals on AirPods over the past week or so, but prices are starting to jump back up quickly and you might want to consider jumping on the $120 price drop on the new AirPods Max 2 while you still can.

Amazon is still offering the Midnight AirPods Max 2 down at the $429 shipped summer deal price. All other colors have now jumped up a touch to $449, so it’s likely only a matter of time before the Midnight follows suit.

Regularly $549, the Midnight set is still $120 off the list price while the rest have now jumped up a touch to $100 off.

This deal is largely a hangover from last week’s major anniversary sale event, and chances are it will be jumping up along with the rest of the colors at anytime now.

This is the second-lowest price we have ever tracked on the 2026 next-generation AirPods Max 2. They were $150 off for a very short stint during the June Prime Day sale, but that is the only time they have ever been that low.

This 48GB M5 Pro MacBook Pro is $400 off today, but this config might be a better option

Amazon is still offering this particularly notable deal on Apple’s 24GB/2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro at $500 off the list price, but we also spotted B&H offering this 48GB M5 Pro for the same price at $400 off.

Now the Amazon model in question here has 24GB of RAM, 2TB of storage, and the upgraded 18-Core/20-Core internals at $2,699 shipped. That’s $500 off the regular $3,199 list price and one of the best deals we have tracked on an M5 Pro in months.

However, if double the RAM will suit you better, B&H is offering the same 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 48GB of RAM, 1TB of storage, and the 15-Core/16-Core setup at the same $2,699 shipped right now.

This machine carries a $3,099 list price and is now $400 off.

So half the RAM, double the storage, and the more powerful internals…or…double the RAM and half the storage with the base internals. Perhaps not a particularly easy decision to make, but both options are, either way, at seriously discounted deal pricing right now.

For me, I tend of favor the RAM over the storage, but 48GB seems a bit overkill and the more powerful Core setup is alluring. I might stick with the Amazon offer personally.

If it’s the 16-inch you’re considering, the official Apple refurb store has notable deals on those:

  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $2,549 (Reg. $2,999 new)
  • Space Black and Silver
  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 48GB/1TB $3,059 (Reg. $3,599 new)

Just in time for the new M6 Mac mini: Samsung’s value-packed 32-inch Smart Monitor is back to its $180 low

Anker’s 7-in-1 Nano Charging Station w/ retractable USB-C, smart display drops to $60 (25% off)

Alongside this morning’s price drop on its clever 10-in-1 clamp-on power strip, Anker’s Amazon storefront has also now dropped the price on its 7-in-1 Nano Charging Station to $60 shipped.

The official Anker Amazon store is now one again offering its 7-in-1 Nano Charging Station down at $59.98 shipped.

Twelve South TimePorter Apple Watch Band Organizer hits best price of year at $21 Prime shipped

Amazon is delivering the best price of the year on the Twelve South TimePorter Watch Strap Organizer. The elegant, mountable organizer neatly stows your Apple Watch bands on display and you can now land one at just under $21 Prime shipped. 

Today’s accessories and charging deals:

  • Satechi’s translucent 4-in-1 USB-C mobile hub with 4K HDMI drops to $38
  • LG’s 32-inch 6K Thunderbolt 5 monitor hits lowest price to undercut Studio Display XDR by a massive $2,200
  • Whisker is offering $100 Labor Day discounts on Litter-Robot bundles starting from $704
  • This ultra-thin UGREEN wallet tracker works with iPhone and Android, and it’s down to just $20 today (All-time low)
  • Twelve South’s AirFly Pro Wireless Audio Transmitter drops to $40 at Amazon (Black or white)

Clean up your desk with Anker’s clever clamp-on power strip, now down to just $58

Latest wireless Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro hits Amazon all-time low at nearly 30% off (Wired model also on sale)

As part of its late summer deals on a range of Fire tablets, Fire TVs, and Blink smart home gear, Amazon is also now delivering its best price ever on the latest wireless Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro and bringing back Prime Day all-time low pricing on the wired model, both at nearly 30% off the list price.

  • Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro $180 (Reg. $250)
  • Ring Wired Doorbell 4K Pro $180 (Reg. $250)

While the brand has since released a more affordable Ring Peephole Cam 2K at $100, today we are featuring some particularly notable deals on its latest Pro-grade 4K models.

The Ring Wired Doorbell 4K Pro is now back down at the Prime Day all-time low for the first time since the late June sale event. This is, in fact, only the second time we have ever tracked this model dropping under $200.

The wireless Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro is now seeing its very first price drop and a subsequent all-time low down at the same $180.

As seen above, both models carry a $250 list price and are now just shy of 30% off for the best deals we can find, and the lowest price we have seen to date.

Both largely the same, boasting up to 10x Enhanced Zoom, night vision, and Retinal 4K with wide-angle video to keep a closer eye on your porch, the wireless model features a Quick Release Ultra Battery Pack for re-charging and an arguably easier installation process (no wiring required), while the Wired model delivers “nonstop power for nonstop protection.”

Scope out our launch coverage from last September for more details.

Anker’s new SmartTrack Find My wallet card for iOS or Android drops to $25 Amazon all-time low

Anker recently released a brand new SmartTrack Find My Card for you wallet – its first to support both Apple’s tracking platform and Google Find Hub – and it has now dropped to a new Amazon all-time low at $25 Prime shipped.

Anker’s official EufyHome shop on Amazon is now offering the new SmartTrack Card E40 for iOS or Android down at $24.99 with free shipping for Prime members or in orders over $35.

It first landed on Amazon at $35 last month and after a light $5 price drop hit later that month, it is now seeing its first notable price drop to deliver a new Amazon all-time low.

You’re looking at nearly 30% off here and a price on par with some of the better deals we have tracked on comparable wallet tracker cards this year.

I’m personally a big fan of the Nomad Tracking Cards – they start at $35 and go up to $45 for the Pro model with 16 months of battery life before it needs a recharge – but no matter which you go with, I think everyone should have one of these things in their wallet or card carrier. I never leave the house without one.

The latest SmartTrack Card E40 from the Anker brand delivers on all of the most important features, including the wireless charging, while also working on either Apple’s Find My platform or Google Find Hub. It measures out at 1.7 mm in thickness and rings out at up to 80 dB to help track it down when you’re nearby – it, of course, loads right up into the Find My and Find Hub apps as well to see its location on the map.

Amazon’s best quality Premium Renewed iPhone 17 Pro units are $220 off today (Matching Prime Day deal)

While the official Apple Certified Refurbished Store is my go-to recommendation for landing deals on iPhone, Apple does not sell its latest iPhone 17 Pro models there yet, and it looks like it won’t until after the 18 series lands next month. Amazon’s best quality Premium Renewed listings have now returned to Prime Day pricing at up to $220 off the new list prices.

Amazon’s top-quality Premium Renewed units have been the best option for landing deals on unlocked iPhone 17 Pro units thus far. Not only are you saving hundreds, but you’re also landing the 1-year Amazon Renewed Guarantee and “greater than 90% original battery life” – the not “premium” renewed and refurbished listings on Amazon only come with a 90-day warranty and you won’t get the same battery life grate either.

Right now you’ll find the 1TB and 512GB iPhone 17 Pro models live again at up to $220 off – the 512GB is now $20 less than our previous mention as well:

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,279 (Reg. $1,499 new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,279 (Reg. $1,499 new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,279 (Reg. $1,499 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,179 (Reg. $1,299 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,179 (Reg. $1,299 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,179 (Reg. $1,299 new)

As detailed in yesterday top picks from the Apple refurb store feature, you can land a perfectly capable iPhone 16 model with a 1-year Apple warranty starting from $699 and a 1TB 16 Pro Max at $1,269 – $330 less than the comparable 17 Pro Max, and $130 less than the 512GB 17 Pro.

  • Refurbished iPhone 16 from $699 (Up to $330 less than series 17)
